# EvDataTable

> A data table presents structured rows and columns with sortable headers, filters, selection, and pagination — built for scanning, comparing, and acting on large datasets.

| Field | Value |
| --- | --- |
| ID | `evoq-ui:data-table` |
| Layer | Organism (`src/organisms`) |
| Import | `import { EvDataTable } from 'evoq-ui'` |
| Template tag | `<EvDataTable>` or `<ev-data-table>` |
| Source | `src/organisms/data-table/EvDataTable.vue` |
| Extra attributes go to | the root `<div class="ev-data-table">` |

## Example

```vue
<EvDataTable title="Karyawan">
  <EvDataTableRow>
    <EvDataTableCell>Alex Wijaya</EvDataTableCell>
  </EvDataTableRow>
  <template #head>
    <EvDataTableRow header>
      <EvDataTableCell header sortable>Nama</EvDataTableCell>
    </EvDataTableRow>
  </template>
</EvDataTable>
```

_The exact snippet the playground simulator copies for this component (`playground/simulator-demos.ts`)._

Its default slot is built to hold `EvDataTableRow` (`evoq-ui:data-table-row`).

## Design guidance

From the Figma page **Data Table**, frame `4220:74017` (Data Table). These rules are binding. Names in them are Figma's - the Vue API is the tables above.

### When to use

- Display large, structured datasets that users need to scan, sort, filter, compare, select, and act on — admin lists, records, transactions, reports.

### When not to use

- For a handful of items or simple key-value pairs → use a list or description list. For non-tabular content → use Cards. On small mobile screens, prefer stacked cards.

### Do

- Right-align numeric columns. Keep headers sortable and concise. Freeze key columns (Left/Right Fixed) for wide tables. Provide pagination or virtual scroll for large sets.

### Don't

- Don't cram too many columns without a fixed/scroll strategy. Don't mix wildly different data types in one column. Don't hide critical actions off-screen.

## Contract

- Only the props, slots and events above exist on `EvDataTable`; anything not listed is not part of its API.
- An attribute that is not a prop (`class`, `id`, `aria-*`, `data-*`) goes to the root `<div class="ev-data-table">`.
- Import it by name from `evoq-ui`; styles come once from `evoq-ui/style.css`.
- Refer to it by id `evoq-ui:data-table` - the id stays the same if the component moves layer.
